description: The common technical indicators for a symbol in one call, from its daily prices: moving averages (SMA and EMA), RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands and ATR, with where the close sits against its 50- and 200-day averages. Standard definitions; describes past prices, not a forecast.

as_of.description: Compute as of this date; default the latest close.

name: technical_indicators

outputSchema.description: Values as of the last close, from daily prices; a null means too little history.

title: Technical indicators
